panels.description: Posting throughput in transactions per second. Derived from rate of posting duration metric (1m window). NFR target: ≥ 10,000 TPS peak.
panels.title: Posting Throughput (TPS)
Posting Latency P50/P95/P99
panels.description: Posting API latency percentiles in milliseconds. NFR: P95 <= 3ms. 5m histogram window.
State machine journal sequence (smJournalSeq) per node. Same as test-cycle lag: SM_journals - DB_journals. Alert if follower lags > 100 behind leader.
panels.title: SM Journal Sequence
Kafka Consumer Lag
panels.description: Kafka consumer group lag and committed offset per topic/partition (kafka-exporter polls broker admin API). Warning > 100, critical > 1000.
JVM heap usage (used vs max) per node. Configured: 2GB per node. Rising heap > 80% indicates memory leak or insufficient heap.
panels.title: JVM Heap Usage

panels.description: Raft last applied log index per node (includes config/no-op entries). Higher than smJournalSeq; use for Raft replication lag vs leader.
panels.title: Raft Last Applied Index
JVM CPU Usage
panels.description: Process and system CPU for ledger nodes and projection (0-100%). In Docker this is cgroup-scoped, not host-wide.
Global command ingress queue depth (CommandQueueManager). Only the leader receives postings; max(ledger_command_queue_depth) across nodes. Default max-size: 50,000.
panels.title: Command Queue Depth

panels.description: Raft leader status per node. 1 = leader (green), 0 = follower (red). Exactly one node should be 1 at any time.
panels.title: Raft Leader Status

panels.description: Posting rejection rate per 5-minute window. Green: 0 rejections. Yellow: 1-10/min. Red: > 10/min. Investigate if sustained red.
panels.title: Posting Rejection Rate

panels.description: Top 5 accounts by command queue depth. Green: < 100. Yellow: 100-500. Red: > 500 (backpressure threshold). Max queue size before rejection is 1000.
panels.title: Account Queue Depth (Top 5)
Raft apply-index lag vs leader (entries behind)

panels.description: Posting rejection rate broken down by error code. Spikes indicate systemic issues (e.g. NOT_LEADER, INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE, PERIOD_CLOSED).
panels.title: Posting Rejection Rate by Error

panels.description: Journal reversal P95 latency. Typically higher than posting due to Raft + cross-period validation. Yellow: 5-15ms. Red: > 15ms.
panels.title: Raft Total Latency P95

panels.description: Apply (state machine) P95 latency — includes deserialize + persist + RocksDB write. Yellow: 5-15ms. Red: > 15ms.
panels.title: Apply (State Machine) Duration P95
Kafka produce vs consume per topic (msgs/s)

panels.description: Outbox events pending in CF_OUTBOX (RocksDB). Events not yet flushed to Kafka. Green: < 1000. Yellow: 1000-10000. Red: > 10000 (Kafka consumer falling behind).
panels.title: Outbox Pending Events

panels.description: Outbox pending count (gauge) and publish rate (events/min). Rising pending with flat publish rate indicates Kafka producer or network issue.
panels.title: Outbox Events Over Time

panels.description: Live balance query P95 latency. NFR target: ≤ 2ms. Covers current balance reads from in-memory state.
panels.title: Balance Query P95 Latency (Live)

panels.description: As-of balance query P95 latency. NFR target: ≤ 30ms. Typically higher as it replays journal entries since snapshot. Yellow: 30-60ms. Red: > 60ms.
panels.title: Balance Query P95 Latency (As-of)
Aurora PostgreSQL Performance
panels.description: Aurora PostgreSQL txn/s, connections, rows inserted/s, plus projection write throughput.

panels.title: Host CPU by mode (steal / iowait / sys / user)
JVM GC Events (per minute)
panels.description: GC pause count per minute across ledger nodes and projection. ZGC target: near-zero on ledger nodes.

panels.title: JVM GC Pause Max (ms)
panels.description: Max GC pause per instance. ZGC target < 1ms. Yellow 1-5ms, red > 5ms.
